Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

SPECIFICATION FOR 

PLATE, BONE, INTERTROCHANTERIC, 

THORNTON TYPE 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of Intertrochanteric bone plate used as an implant in 
orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Material — Any of the materials specified in 3 of IS:5347-1969 'General requirements of metal 
surgical implants'. 

3. Shape and Dimensions— As shown in Fig. 1.

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The plates shall be made in one piece to the required shape.

IS: 6790 -1973 

4.2 The holes shall be well-made and uniform in spacing and shall be symmetrical with respect to the 
central line. 

4.3 The tongue shall have serrations on underside to hold the nail firmly. The serrations shall match 
with the serrations of the corresponding Smith Peterson nail. 

4.4 All sharp edges shall be removed* 

4.5 The plate shall be free from pits, cracks burrs, blemishes and other surface defects. 

4.6 The plate shall be passivated and polished bright. 

4.7 Screws shall fit in the plate holes perfectly and there shall be no protruding edges of the screws. 

4.8 Smith Peterson nail used shall be in accordance with IS: 5846-1 970. 

4.9 The threads and serrations wherever provided shall be well-formed and clean. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — Shall be according to 6.1 of IS: 5347-1969. 

5.2 Radiological Test — Shall be according to 6.2 of IS : 5347-1 969. 

6. Marking — Shall be according to 5 of IS: 5347-1 969. 

6.1 IS/ Certification Marking— Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Defhi 1. 

7. Packing — The plates maybe packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 
However, it is recommended that each plate, bolt and the washer may be wrapped in polyethylene 
bag or in wax paper and then packed in cartons.
